cohort: Pregnant women with live singleton deliveries in Guangzhou, China
finding: A lower pre-pregnancy BMI cutoff at 25 kg/m2 for defining obesity, as recommended by the WHO for Asian populations, may be more appropriate for pregnant women in South China than the WGOC cutoff of 28 kg/m2.
mod_finding: Women with obesity who underwent cesarean section had a higher risk of adverse maternal and perinatal outcomes.
